comments.author: Simon
comments.text:
Hi Simona,

You're right that there isn't much advice for listening. Just be ready for tricks (e.g. they say something then change it) and move on if you can't answer a question.

The most important thing is concentration - listening very carefully.

...

Hi Ahmed,

I've got used to = I have become accustomed to

familiar with.

I used to = a past habit

(We don't say 'I have used to')

...

Hi Marya,

1. It's fine to use 'always' with present perfect. It means 'for my whole life until now'.

2. I changed to 'you' to make a general statement about everyone - we can all achieve more when working as a team.

Hope this helps
